title: VIXEN build wrapper requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT for Text configuration
body: The documented root build-wsl.sh invokes the vixen-wsl preset without exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT, so configure fails at libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 before any target can build. Workaround: rerun the queued build with UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-hlsl. Suggested consolidation: have the VIXEN build wrapper or preset derive/validate the paired Undertow root declaratively and pass it to consumers.

title: RenderGraph UI tests require executable-directory working directory for staged assets
body: Directly invoking the freshly built test binaries from the VIXEN repository root makes test_ui_composition_host fail four document-loading cases because CMake stages assets/ui next to the executable and RmlUi resolves relative paths from the process CWD. Workaround: run the queued focused tests after cd build/wsl/libraries/RenderGraph/tests (the CTest-style executable directory). Suggested consolidation: set the test target WORKING_DIRECTORY to its binary directory or make asset resolution independent of CWD.
